name: finova
description: Finova — A Kite-inspired stock market paper-trading simulator

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c blue,green "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=client && npm run typecheck --workspace=server
